description: The declared schema of Rihmasto's own records: which kinds of record exist, which links between them are allowed, how each link is known, and who may see each kind. The knowledge graph (kernel/graph.py) is rebuilt from the records on every read and checked against this file. Changes go through the factory's own contract, which only the owner amends.

origins.kernel: the kernel wrote the link itself, by a fixed rule
origins.convention: a naming convention links the two records, such as a test named after its criterion
origins.model_proposed: a model proposed the link and no person has decided on it yet; never used by a write path
origins.person_confirmed: a named person made or decided the record that holds the link

audiences.person: a named person in the cockpit or on the command line
audiences.assistant: the cockpit's chat assistant, answering a person
audiences.verifier: the read-only reviewer at the gate

request.label: Request
request.description: The need as it was asked: the project's request, and the person who asked.

question.label: Question
question.description: A question the intake panel asked; a person answers it, or the factory assumes an answer.

assumption.label: Assumption
assumption.description: An answer the factory took for itself, with a due date, until a person confirms or refutes it.

person.label: Person
person.description: A named person: a name exactly as the records give it, never an identity. The persona a person acted as is a qualifier on the link.
person.source: the answers and decisions that name them

requirement.label: Requirement@v
requirement.description: One requirement as one spec version states it. A plain id (R-1) names the requirement across versions.

criterion.label: Criterion
criterion.description: One acceptance criterion, keyed by a hash of its given, when and then, so a restated criterion is a new node and an old link to its id is ambiguous after the amendment.

task.label: Task
task.description: A contract task: the work that serves a requirement's criteria.

test.label: Test
test.description: A test on the product's main whose name names a criterion (test_R_1_AC_2_...).

holdout_ref.label: HoldoutRef
holdout_ref.description: A criterion checked outside the build: its id, its criterion, its kind and the verdicts releases recorded. Never its scenario, which stays in the holdout custody.

card.label: Card
card.description: An Inbox card: a proposal waiting for a person. Its title, body and payload are never in the graph.

decision.label: Decision
decision.description: A named person's decision on a card, or an answer recorded without one. Its reason is never in the graph.

release.label: Release
release.description: A release of the product: its revision, the requirements it carries and how far it got.

pack.label: Pack
pack.description: A capability pack version, pinned to the release it was built for.

round.label: Round
round.description: One builder cell round of a task.

model.label: Model
model.description: A model a round ran on, by the id the run record gives.

revision.label: Revision
revision.description: A git revision of the product that a round produced.
revision.source: cell_ran and merged in the ledger

signal.label: Signal
signal.description: A need or remark that arrived in the delivery square. Its text is outside text and never in the graph.

observation.label: Observation
observation.description: An outside event the factory recorded (a model, a CVE, drift). Only its id is in the graph.

comment.label: Comment
comment.description: A remark a person made about a record. Its text is outside text and never in the graph.

derived_from.label: derived from
derived_from.description: A requirement version rests on its sources: a question, the request, a change card, or a person's edit of the plan.

revision_of.label: revision of
revision_of.description: A requirement version replaces the same requirement's previous version.
revision_of.carried_by: the spec snapshots, in version order

amended_by.label: amended by
amended_by.description: A requirement version was written by applying a change card.

answered_by.label: answered by
answered_by.description: A question was answered by a named person, acting as a persona.

assumed_as.label: assumed as
assumed_as.description: A question was answered by an assumption the factory took (a person may have chosen to let it).

has_criterion.label: has criterion
has_criterion.description: A requirement version states an acceptance criterion.
has_criterion.carried_by: each requirement's acceptance, and the criterion id's prefix

checked_by.label: checked by
checked_by.description: A criterion is checked by a test on main that names it, or by a held-out check.
checked_by.carried_by: test names on main; check.ref in the contract

serves.label: serves
serves.description: A contract task serves a criterion.

depends_on.label: depends on
depends_on.description: A contract task runs after another.

round_of.label: round of
round_of.description: A builder cell round worked on a task.

ran_on.label: ran on
ran_on.description: A round ran on a model (and, when it escalated, on the model it escalated to).

produced.label: produced
produced.description: A round produced a revision of the product.

carries.label: carries
carries.description: A release carries a requirement, at the spec version in force when the release started.

versions.label: versions
versions.description: A capability pack version pins a release.

signed_by.label: signed by
signed_by.description: A decision was made by a named person, acting as a persona.

approves.label: approves
approves.description: An approving decision approves a release.

concerns.label: concerns
concerns.description: A card, or a decision that does not approve, is about a release.

rests_on.label: rests on
rests_on.description: A card, or the decision on it, rests on a requirement: an amendment of that requirement makes an approval stale.

invalidated_by.label: invalidated by
invalidated_by.description: An approval went stale because a change card (or, when the ledger names none, an amended requirement) changed what it rested on.

touches.label: touches
touches.description: A triaged change names the requirements it would touch. A model's list stays model_proposed until a person decides the card.

asks.label: asks
asks.description: A question card puts a question to a person.

settles.label: settles
settles.description: A card or decision is about an assumption: a refuted assumption's change card, or the decision that confirmed or refuted it.

about_criterion.label: about criterion
about_criterion.description: A card or decision is about criteria, such as a holdout ruling on the criteria whose checks failed.

about_task.label: about task
about_task.description: A card or decision is about a task, such as an escalation.

raised_from.label: raised from
raised_from.description: A card was raised from a signal or an observation.
raised_from.carried_by: refs.signal, refs.observation, and routed_to in the factory's signals.json

split_from.label: split from
split_from.description: A change card is one part of feedback that triage split.

routed_from.label: routed from
routed_from.description: A road card was routed to IT from a change card.

about.label: about
about.description: A comment is about a requirement, criterion, task, release or card.

release.note: approves, on a decision that approves

perspective.attribute: the panel perspective a question card speaks for

source.attribute: the persona a change came from

scope.attribute: what an approval covers: plan, factory or trial

spec_version.attribute: the spec version a plan approval is for

redone.attribute: a rejected plan card whose spec was drafted again

registry.attribute: the registry a publication's deploy gate is for (kernel/publish.py)

environment.attribute: the environment an incident happened in

environments.attribute: the environments a road card asks IT to configure

roads.attribute: the road names a road card asks IT to configure

trigger.attribute: the trigger of the observation an update card is about

trial.attribute: a sandbox trial's id; the Trial kind is planned (phase 2)

workspace.attribute: the branch of a person's workspace

person.attribute: the person a workspace card is for

connector.attribute: the connector (its system name) a connector card asks IT to turn on

message.attribute: the agent channel message a post answers or follows (kernel/agent_channel.py)

commits.attribute: the commits an agent's channel post names

checks.attribute: the checks an agent's channel post or gate request names
